findings.text: non-blocking: galerkin_block_spectrum(gram, mirrored) is called only for its returned metric, so a full generalised eigvalsh runs on the study's largest matrix for a result the caller discards, and a LAPACK failure there aborts a step that needs no spectrum.

non-blocking: the solve guard is file-level, so a copy added beside an existing owner call exits 0 (reproduced by appending a working eigh(..., metric) solve to localise.py) and callers() counts only attribute calls, so a bare-name owner import beside an unrelated block_diag use would be a false positive.
